justListed.lead: A 1940 bungalow with new wiring, plumbing, roof and siding.
justListed.about: This 1940 bungalow in Houston has a new roof, new siding, and new wiring and plumbing. The kitchen has white upper cabinets, dark lower cabinets, marble-look counters and a bar that seats three. The living and dining rooms are open to each other, with a breakfast nook off the kitchen. The primary bedroom has a vaulted ceiling, and the back patio is covered.

master: This 1940 bungalow in Houston has a new roof, new siding, and new wiring and plumbing.
It has three bedrooms, two full baths and 1,385 square feet, all on one floor.
The front door opens to a living room that runs into the dining area, with wood-look floors throughout.
The kitchen has white upper cabinets, dark lower cabinets, marble-look counters, stainless appliances and a bar that seats three.
A breakfast nook with windows on two sides sits next to the kitchen.
The primary bedroom has a vaulted ceiling and a double-door closet.
